body: Runtime styles now implemented and browserJS13/13 green: WidgetTargetStyle(fill,stroke,opacity), setTargetStyles(Map[VisualTargetId,...]), atomic unknown/invalid/raster-stroke rejection, retained point batches and per-cell raster paint. SVG/Canvas use same transformed scene; no state/event/window mutation, empty map restores original, pan/zoom retains styles, explicit update clears view-bound styles. Paired actual-pixel browser check running. Target-ID API covers aggregate targets without guessing membership. Will send fresh SHA after test/rebase.
